name: speed_mps
current_definition: Speed as reported in the message payload.
current_rationale: Spoofed-speed attacks report values outside the plausible range.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Claimed speed may be jointly forged with position; high speed alone is not proof of abuse.

name: signal_strength_dbm
current_definition: Receiver-measured RSSI of the radio frame carrying the message.
current_rationale: A transmitter whose RSSI does not match its claimed distance is suspicious; also separates a nearby flooder from distant traffic.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Receiver measurement only; multipath, power control and missing radio telemetry undermine simple distance interpretations.

name: position_jump_m
current_definition: Euclidean distance between this report's (x, y) and the previous report's (x, y) from the same sender ID.
current_rationale: Position spoofing teleports the claimed location.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Depends on projected coordinates, timestamp order, GNSS uncertainty and pseudonym continuity.

name: jump_excess_m
current_definition: position_jump_m - max(speed_mps, prev_speed_mps) * dt_prev_s, where dt_prev_s is clamped at >= 0. Positive means the sender moved further than its own reported speed can explain.
current_rationale: Separates a real fast vehicle (jump explained by speed) from a teleport (jump unexplained). Needs no division, so it stays finite when two reports share a timestamp.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: The sender controls position and speed; coordinated false trajectories can satisfy this check. A residual is not an invariant of truth.

name: speed_change_excess_mps
current_definition: |speed_change_mps| - PLAUSIBLE_ACCEL_MPS2 * dt_prev_s (dt clamped at >= 0). Positive means the speed changed faster than hard braking or full acceleration allows.
current_rationale: Keeps a legitimate hard brake (explained by elapsed time) apart from a fabricated speed step.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: The 6 m/s^2 constant is a demo assumption, not a universal physical maximum.

name: heading_change_abs_rad
current_definition: |wrap_to_pi(heading - previous heading)|, i.e. the shorter angular distance, so 359 deg -> 1 deg is 2 deg and not 358 deg.
current_rationale: A sudden large turn is physically impossible at road speed.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Must normalize true-north/clockwise versus +x/counter-clockwise headings; small elapsed time and stationary heading need explicit handling.

name: sender_msgs_in_window
current_definition: Number of messages received from this sender ID in the last RATE_WINDOW_S seconds, including the current one.
current_rationale: Direct, causal measure of per-identity flooding. Replaces the old 1/dt message rate, which collapsed to 0 on duplicate timestamps.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Legitimate adaptive beacon rates and duplicate reception can change counts; rates belong to one receiver view.

name: duplicate_payloads_in_window
current_definition: Messages from this sender ID inside the window whose (x, y) is within DUP_POSITION_TOL_M and speed within DUP_SPEED_TOL_MPS of the current report, excluding the current one.
current_rationale: A flooding transmitter cannot physically move between its own back-to-back frames, so its reports repeat.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: A stopped car can send unchanged telemetry; approximate equality is not a replay-proof identifier.

name: sender_age_s
current_definition: Simulation time since the first message ever seen from this sender ID.
current_rationale: Sybil identities are young. A legitimately joining vehicle is also young, which is exactly why this feature alone is not sufficient - see cospatial_senders.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Tracks observed pseudonym age, not physical vehicle age; legitimate pseudonym rotation resets history.

name: cospatial_senders
current_definition: Number of OTHER sender IDs whose most recent reported position lies within COSPATIAL_RADIUS_M of this report's position.
current_rationale: Two identities cannot occupy the same few metres of road. This is the only feature that gives the receiver real evidence of a Sybil clone rather than of a new arrival.
evidence_status: implemented in synthetic baseline; external validity untested
deployment_caveat: Distinct legitimate road users can be within 5 m; spoofed identities can deliberately spread out.
